enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.talk_success_min: backs away grumbling, deciding you're more trouble than you're worth
enemies.talk_success_max: digs through its pockets and reluctantly produces something it was saving
enemies.retreat_excuse: The goblin squints at you, announces it has a very important appointment elsewhere, and leaves at speed.
enemies.description: Small, fast, aggressively opportunistic. Has opinions about property rights that differ significantly from yours.

enemies.name: Giant Rat
enemies.talk_success_min: sniffs you once more, decides you are not food, and retreats
enemies.talk_success_max: nudges something toward you with its nose — apparently a peace offering
enemies.retreat_excuse: The rat pauses, looks at something only it can see, and disappears into a gap in the wall.
enemies.description: Organized. Aggressive. Significantly larger than advertised.

enemies.name: Skeleton
enemies.talk_success_min: stops mid-swing, rattles thoughtfully, and stands aside
enemies.talk_success_max: reaches into its ribcage and produces something it has been holding for a very long time
enemies.retreat_excuse: The skeleton freezes, looks at its own hands as if reconsidering its life choices, and collapses into a pile. Not dead. Just done.
enemies.description: Persistent. Slow. Has been at this for some time and sees no reason to stop.

enemies.name: Sewer Goblin
enemies.talk_success_min: lowers its improvised weapon and explains, at length, that this tunnel is its home
enemies.talk_success_max: decides you are the first interesting visitor in weeks and produces something from a hidden shelf
enemies.retreat_excuse: The sewer goblin remembers it left something on the stove. It did not leave anything on the stove. It leaves anyway.
enemies.description: Has made a home here. Objects to your presence with personal investment.

enemies.name: Crystal Toad
enemies.talk_success_min: regards you for a long moment, croaks once with finality, and hops aside
enemies.talk_success_max: produces a perfectly formed crystal from somewhere on its person and places it at your feet
enemies.retreat_excuse: The toad inflates to an impressive size, holds it for a moment, deflates, and hops away with great dignity.
enemies.description: Large. Crystalline. Surprisingly formal about the whole thing.

enemies.name: Cave Bat Swarm
enemies.talk_success_min: the swarm loses interest collectively and disperses to the ceiling
enemies.talk_success_max: one bat, clearly the leader, drops something before following the others
enemies.retreat_excuse: The swarm suddenly finds the other end of the cave vastly more interesting. They leave at speed. You are grateful.
enemies.description: Individually manageable. Collectively a different problem entirely.

enemies.name: Forest Wolf
enemies.talk_success_min: holds your gaze for a long moment, then steps off the path
enemies.talk_success_max: turns away, pauses, and nudges something from the undergrowth toward you before leaving
enemies.retreat_excuse: The wolf tilts its head, sniffs something on the wind, and trots away with purpose. You are not the priority right now.
enemies.description: Not hunting. Waiting. These are different and you can feel it.

enemies.name: Treant Sapling
enemies.talk_success_min: stills its branches and considers your words with what appears to be genuine reflection
enemies.talk_success_max: reaches into its own bark and offers something preserved there for longer than you've been alive
enemies.retreat_excuse: The treant stops, looks at the ground, appears to remember it is rooted here by choice, and slowly returns to looking like a tree.
enemies.description: Slow. Strong. Provoked by your presence in a way that feels personal.

enemies.name: Spider Guard
enemies.talk_success_min: retreats to the edge of the web and waits, watching you pass
enemies.talk_success_max: produces a small silk-wrapped bundle and leaves it at the web's edge
enemies.retreat_excuse: The spider abruptly retreats to the ceiling, curls its legs in, and becomes very interested in being somewhere else.
enemies.description: Administrative. Territorial. Has a job to do and would prefer to continue doing it without you here.

enemies.name: Orc Warrior
enemies.talk_success_min: lowers its weapon with visible reluctance and allows passage
enemies.talk_success_max: grunts with what might be respect and throws you something from its pack
enemies.retreat_excuse: The orc looks at you, looks at its weapon, decides the math doesn't work, and walks away.
enemies.description: Experienced. Efficient. Not unreasonable if approached correctly.

enemies.name: Dark Mage
enemies.talk_success_min: dismisses you with a gesture, clearly bored
enemies.talk_success_max: offers a trade — something of theirs for your silence about having seen them here
enemies.retreat_excuse: The mage produces a dramatic smoke effect, steps backward into it, and is gone. The smoke smells like burnt ambition.
enemies.description: Powerful. Impatient. Has somewhere to be and you are not it.

enemies.name: Stone Golem
enemies.talk_success_min: stops. Stands still. That's it. You can pass.
enemies.talk_success_max: stops, and something falls from a crack in its chest that it apparently didn't know was there
enemies.retreat_excuse: The golem freezes mid-motion. Stays frozen. You get the sense it will resume eventually. Not soon.
enemies.description: Ancient. Indifferent. Has not yet factored you into its calculations.

enemies.name: Dragon Whelp
enemies.talk_success_min: snorts fire at nothing in particular and flies to a higher ledge, pointedly ignoring you
enemies.talk_success_max: drops something from its hoard — apparently deciding the weight isn't worth it
enemies.retreat_excuse: The whelp has decided this was beneath it from the beginning. It leaves. With style.
enemies.description: Territorial. Theatrical. Takes offense easily and at length.
